cut_now: Do not build a web app server.
Do not build live source connectors.
Do not implement downstream app repos yet.
Do not add complex dashboards, auth, or persistence beyond the existing file-backed runtime.
watch: Report generation must not become a second source of truth.
The report should surface evidence and boundaries rather than smoothing them away.
Avoid hardcoded business scoring or qualitative judgments in report code.
minimum_scope: Generate a static HTML report from an executed trace output directory and wire the demo script to run the agent activation trace.
rationale: A static trace report is the smallest useful user-test surface because it exercises the existing runtime and makes the agent activation contract inspectable.
